name: starbit-terminal
description: A cozy, Nintendo-inspired terminal panel for VS Code with slot tabs, splits, two themes — plus a Claude Code panel where permission prompts and questions are real gel keys.
author: Brandon Reuss

untrustedWorkspaces.description: StarBit runs shells and Claude Code with settings (shell, autoCommand, claudePath) that a workspace could override.

starbit.shell.description: Shell executable to launch. Leave empty to use your default shell ($SHELL on macOS/Linux, PowerShell on Windows).

starbit.autoCommand.description: Command typed into every new terminal automatically, e.g. 'claude'. Leave empty for a plain shell.

starbit.commandBits.description: Command bits on the terminal bar: coloured ✦ keys that type a command into the focused terminal. Add and edit them from the bar (the + socket, or right-click a bit), or here.

label.description: Shown on hover. Falls back to the command.

command.description: Typed into the terminal, followed by Enter.

starbit.fontFamily.default: "M PLUS 1 Code", "SF Mono", "Cascadia Code", "JetBrains Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "DejaVu Sans Mono", monospace
starbit.fontFamily.description: Font family for the terminal. Defaults to the bundled M PLUS 1 Code (rounded, Nintendo-flavored).

starbit.theme.description: Color theme: 'light' (Basic White, 3DS-style) or 'dark' (Basic Black, Switch-style). The sun/moon key in either panel toggles and saves this.

starbit.claudePath.description: Path to the Claude Code binary used by the Claude panel. Leave empty to use the `claude` found by your login shell (or ~/.local/bin/claude).

enumDescriptions: Ask before every tool that needs permission
Auto-accept file edits, ask for the rest
Plan first; no tools run until you approve
starbit.claude.defaultMode.description: Permission mode new Claude sessions start in. The mode key in the panel changes it per session.

starbit.claude.model.description: Model for new Claude sessions (e.g. 'opus', 'sonnet'). Empty = Claude Code's default.

starbit.claude.debug.description: Forward the Claude Code process's stderr into the panel's webview console (Help → Toggle Developer Tools).

starbit.claude.sidePanels.description: Use the space beside the Claude transcript for side rails: a terminal on the right (in the workspace folder, whenever the panel has room for it) and, when the panel is wide (e.g. maximized), a session-stats rail on the left.
